* `push_back(ele);`                                         //尾部插入元素ele
* `pop_back();`                                                //删除最后一个元素
* `insert(const_iterator pos, ele);`        //迭代器指向位置pos插入元素ele
* `insert(const_iterator pos, int count,ele);`//迭代器指向位置pos插入count个元素ele
* `erase(const_iterator pos);`                     //删除迭代器指向的元素

b8f4edb6f035d55ba02ce485478ff430f3b01f8c.translatedText:
* `push_back(ele);`                                         //Insert element ele at the end
* `pop_back();`                                                //Delete the last element
* `insert(const_iterator pos, ele);`        //Insert element ele at the position pointed to by the iterator pos
* `insert(const_iterator pos, int count,ele);`//Insert count copies of element ele at the position pointed to by the iterator pos
* `erase(const_iterator pos);`                     //Delete the element pointed to by the iterator
* `erase(const_iterator start, const_iterator end);`//Delete the elements between start and end pointed to by the iterators
* `clear();`                                                        //Delete all elements in the container
